Swordfish Steak

About This Entry

Swordfish steak is meaty and grill-friendly — kebabs and char. Rosé, medium-bodied whites, and lighter reds (Pinot Noir) suit capers and olives.

Beginner Guide

Dense texture tolerates grill; avoid rare center for food safety guidance.

FAQ

What is Swordfish Steak?
Dense texture tolerates grill; avoid rare center for food safety guidance.
How should Swordfish Steak be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
